Checking whether a model's assumptions hold up is the same discipline that sound pricing and risk work needs.

On the technical side, I list SQL, Python (Pandas, NumPy), R, Tableau and advanced Excel on my resume, and my M.A. in International Economics & Finance from Brandeis (STEM) gave me a quantitative base. I also researched AI tools at FYND K.K. in Tokyo and co-authored a 15-page report for the founders, so I am comfortable with the AI-assisted way your team works.

You describe this as an entry-level role for someone curious and detail-oriented, and that fits me. I am a U.S. citizen, available immediately, and happy to work remotely.

Sincerely,
Alexander Airapetian
